technicalResolution.text:
F1: preserved deferred binding and restoration

Resolve F1's “existing” deferred compatibility, binding, receipt, reservation/freshness and restoration controls to the specific meanings expressly preserved by current F1, using historical specification 2891d85620ce153f83cdac20edb143a6fa06a7e5 SHA-256 a610714d14a6cff6386fc432f071e90507910d844ded7f32d87e110ade88cc8c §32.4A lines2872–2892; approved compatibility proposal SHA-256 06c888569c9eaca414bde1926940cf596838fc2dd12c4ff7d4295e05d27ea22f lines11–74; and retained recovery instruction SHA-256 e921bf3acf1153dd0a65f2b577bcd5ecddff25eac441bc863926e402a7c71988 lines26–55. Historical §16.1A lines1283–1345, including its custom condition grammar and phase-target table, is retained solely as historical/migration comparison evidence, not a current canonical language or independent source of current phase constraints. This identifies preserved lineage under current F1, not blanket re-adoption of omitted historical clauses.

Approved v4 B lines28–37 governs TARGET_AVAILABILITY_CONDITION for these deferred definitions as for the other owning records. Its canonical value is a required, non-null closed object with exactly the required non-null PROOF_EXPRESSION_ID canonical proofExpressions ID string, installed only by the application through the existing relationship-admission path. Initial structural admission/ID installation is separate from readiness/evaluation, which requires the exact accepted, current proofExpressions contract and review. Evaluation uses only the existing LEAF, ALL_OF, ANY_OF and AT_LEAST_K proof language, valid leaf targets and current evidence/scope/identity/byte rules. F1 preserves current due/phase, definition/test/fixture/target/outcome, custody, receipt and restoration duties; it does not preserve PHASE_TARGET, CURRENT_RECORD, VERIFIED_ARTIFACT_BYTES or any additional condition-node representation as a second canonical language. A phase constraint may enter the current effective predicate only when required by the current governing source. Lossless migration must demonstrate equivalence of the whole effective target/evidence/scope and TRUE/FALSE/UNKNOWN predicate, including every such independently source-required phase constraint, rather than only equivalence of the old serialized object. Missing equivalence leaves affected timing/proofs stale pending reauthoring and review. Existing compliant observation functions/evaluators may be retained only with outputs bound to the accepted proof contract and demonstrated equivalence; no old helper or phase target is grandfathered merely because it existed.

Preserve the accepted independently reviewed test/definition/fixture/target/outcome relationship; exact raw/native provenance and identities/hashes; supported compatibility with its honest basis; current selected stage/op/scope/history activation; bound reservation/retry/confirmation; actual isolation and input custody; distinct PRE failure/POST success execution and target identities. Later routes remain receipt-only and future work visible/unexecuted. Retain coherent saved accepted work and pending candidates as pending without replay; reject late abandoned results and mixed-version authority. Missing historical support cannot migrate to favorable current proof. Current schema/serialization remains only an implementation of those duties and must pass source/field/producer/consumer review. No new executor, store, writer permission or proof-basis upgrade is introduced.
